sourceEvidence.title: Sr. Infrastructure Incident Manager, IT Infrastructure Engineering
sourceEvidence.quote:
# Austin, TX, US
## Summary
Work with Program Managers and teams to get incident follow ups prioritized and completed
Work closely with NOC Team Analysts to streamline and improve process and documentation
Ensure all incidents are tagged with critical incident data
Build and maintain dashboards and reports for analysis of incident Trend data by Team, MTTA/MTTR by Team
What You'll Bring
3+ years of additional equivalent experience or evidence of exceptional ability related to the position
Experience with troubleshooting distributed systems
Strong knowledge of multiple observability tools: Splunk, Prometheus/Alert Manager, Synthetic Monitoring, Grafana
Basic understanding of Linux fundamentals (Ubuntu/RHEL OS)
Basic understanding of Network and Traffic fundamentals
Basic understanding of modern software architecture workflow and common design patterns
Experience in collaborating with network and data center teams for large scale infrastructure support
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience
Sound judgement, outstanding communication, & ability to work with internal customers in a fast-paced, high visibility role
Benefits
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
